accepted.summary: Restricted-entry interval (REI) prohibition
accepted.quote: DO NOT enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the restricted-entry interval (REI) of 48 hours.

accepted.applies_to: early entry to treated areas involving contact with treated items
accepted.summary: Required PPE list header for early entry
accepted.quote: PPE required for early entry to treated areas that is permitted under the Worker Protection Standard and that involves contact with anything that has been treated, such as plants, soil, or water is:

accepted.summary: Minimum interval between sequential applications of other herbicides after Axial XL Herbicide
accepted.quote: For optimum results, apply Axial XL Herbicide first and allow at least 4 days after application of Axial XL Herbicide before applying these herbicides sequentially.

accepted.summary: Minimum spray volume when applying with ground or aerial equipment
accepted.quote: Apply the specified rate of Axial XL Herbicide using ground or aerial equipment, in a minimum of 5 gal. of water per acre (see Ground and Aerial Application Procedures section for additional information).

accepted.summary: Control weeds in field borders to prevent influx of weeds
accepted.quote: Prevent an influx of weeds into the field by controlling weeds in field borders.

accepted.summary: Scout fields after application to verify treatment effectiveness
accepted.quote: Scout fields after application to verify that the treatment was effective.

accepted.summary: Identify suspected herbicide-resistant weeds using specified indicators
accepted.quote: Suspected- herbicide resistant weeds may be identified by these indicators • Failure to control a weed species normally controlled by the herbicide at the dose applied, especially if control is achieved on adjacent weeds; • A spreading patch of non-controlled plants of a particular weed species; and • Surviving plants mixed with controlled individuals of the same species.

accepted.summary: Control weed escapes using effective mode of action herbicide or non-chemical means if resistance suspected
accepted.quote: If resistance is suspected ensure weed escapes are controlled using an herbicide with an effective mode of action and/or use non-chemical means to prevent further seed production.

accepted.summary: Do not allow weed escapes to produce seed or vegetative structures
accepted.quote: DO NOT allow weed escapes to produce seed or vegetative structures for example tubers or stolons which contribute to spread and survival.

accepted.summary: Consider harvest weed seed management and post-harvest weed control to prevent seed production
accepted.quote: Consider harvest weed seed management and control weeds post-harvest to prevent seed production.

accepted.applies_to: spring wheat (excluding durum), winter wheat, and barley
accepted.summary: Application allowed from 2-leaf stage to pre-boot stage
accepted.quote: Apply Axial XL Herbicide to all varieties of spring wheat (excluding durum), winter wheat, and barley from the 2-leaf stage to pre-boot stage.

accepted.summary: Prohibited when crop is stressed by specified conditions
accepted.quote: DO NOT apply to a crop that is stressed by conditions such as frost, low fertility, drought, flooding, disease damage, or insect damage, as crop injury may result.

accepted.summary: Release height must not exceed 10 ft above ground or vegetative canopy unless necessary for pilot safety
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 ft above the ground or vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: Must use medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572)
accepted.quote: Applicators are required to use a medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572).

accepted.summary: Must not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at application site
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.summary: Must not apply during temperature inversions
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: Must use medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572)
accepted.quote: Applicators are required to use a medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572).

accepted.summary: When wind speed ≤ 10 mph, must use ½ swath displacement upwind at downwind edge of field
accepted.quote: If the windspeed is 10 miles per hour or less, applicators must use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.

accepted.summary: When wind speed is between 11-15 mph, must use ¾ swath displacement upwind at downwind edge of field
accepted.quote: When the windspeed is between 11-15 miles per hour, applicators must use ¾ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.

accepted.summary: Must not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at application site
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at the application site.

accepted.summary: Boom length must be ≤ 65% of wingspan (fixed-wing) or ≤ 75% of rotor diameter (helicopter) when wind > 10 mph; otherwise ≤ 75% of wingspan (fixed-wing) or ≤ 90% of rotor diameter (helicopter)
accepted.quote: If the windspeed is greater than 10 mph, the boom length must be 65% or less of the wingspan for fixed wing aircraft and 75% or less of the rotor diameter for helicopters. Otherwise, the boom length must be 75% or less of the wingspan for fixed-wing aircraft and 90% or less of the rotor diameter for helicopters.

accepted.quote: If the windspeed is greater than 10 mph, the boom length must be 65% or less of the wingspan for fixed wing aircraft and 75% or less of the rotor diameter for helicopters. Otherwise, the boom length must be 75% or less of the wingspan for fixed-wing aircraft and 90% or less of the rotor diameter for helicopters.

accepted.summary: Must not apply during ground-level temperature inversions
accepted.quote: Do not apply during ground level temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: Release height must not exceed 4 ft above ground or crop canopy
accepted.quote: User must only apply with the release height recommended by the manufacturer, but no more than 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.summary: Follow nozzle manufacturer’s recommendations for setting up nozzles when applying via aircraft.
accepted.quote: Adjust Nozzles - Follow nozzle manufacturers’ recommendations for setting up nozzles.

accepted.summary: Orient nozzles parallel with airflow in flight to reduce fine droplets (advisory).
accepted.quote: Generally, to reduce fine droplets, nozzles should be oriented parallel with the airflow in flight.

accepted.summary: Boom should remain level with the crop and have minimal bounce for ground equipment (advisory).
accepted.quote: For ground equipment, the boom should remain level with the crop and have minimal bounce.

accepted.summary: Avoid higher release heights due to increased spray drift potential (advisory).
accepted.quote: Higher release heights increase the potential for spray drift.

accepted.summary: Use larger droplets in hot and dry conditions to reduce evaporation effects (advisory).
accepted.quote: When making applications in hot and dry conditions, use larger droplets to reduce effects of evaporation.

accepted.summary: Prohibited: Applications during temperature inversions.
accepted.quote: Avoid applications during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: Prohibited: Applications during gusty wind conditions.
accepted.quote: AVOID APPLICATIONS DURING GUSTY WIND CONDITIONS.

accepted.summary: Apply only when wind direction minimizes drift toward sensitive areas.
accepted.quote: This pesticide may only be applied when the potential for drift to adjacent sensitive areas, e.g., residential areas, bodies of water, non-target plants is minimal, (i.e., when the wind is blowing away from the sensitive area.)

accepted.summary: Prevent contact with non-labeled crops via drift or overspray.
accepted.quote: Avoid all direct or indirect contact (such as spray drift) of Axial XL Herbicide with crops other than those specified for treatment on this label, since injury may occur.

accepted.summary: Prohibit chemigation application.
accepted.quote: DO NOT apply this product through any type of irrigation system.

accepted.applies_to: spring wheat (excluding durum), winter wheat, and barley
accepted.summary: Prohibit spray drift to non-target crops
accepted.quote: DO NOT allow spray to drift to adjacent fields seeded to crops other than wheat or barley.

accepted.applies_to: wheat or barley underseeded to forages
accepted.summary: Prohibit application when crop is underseeded to forages
accepted.quote: DO NOT treat wheat or barley underseeded to forages.

accepted.applies_to: all varieties of spring wheat (excluding durum), winter wheat, and barley
accepted.summary: Limit total seasonal application to 16.4 fl oz per acre over 12 months
accepted.quote: Make one application per crop season, not to exceed 16.4 fl. oz. of Axial XL Herbicide per acre per 12 consecutive months.

accepted.summary: Prohibit grazing or forage harvest within 30 days post-application
accepted.quote: DO NOT graze livestock or harvest forage for hay from treated wheat and barley for a minimum of 30 days following application.

accepted.summary: Prohibit grain harvest within 60 days post-application
accepted.quote: DO NOT harvest grain for 60 days following application.

accepted.summary: Allow feeding of straw to livestock starting 60 days post-application
accepted.quote: Wheat and barley straw may be fed to livestock 60 days after application.

accepted.applies_to: wild oat, volunteer oat, green foxtail, yellow foxtail, Italian (annual) ryegrass, and broadleaf weeds

accepted.quote: CDO NOT exceed 0.8 pt./A of Bronate Advanced in a tank mix for control of Italian (annual) ryegrass, green foxtail, or yellow foxtail.

accepted.applies_to: Axial XL Herbicide tank mixes containing Buctril for control of Italian (annual) ryegrass, green foxtail, or yellow foxtail

accepted.quote: EDO NOT exceed 0.6 oz./A of Harmony SG + 0.8 pt./A of Bronate Advanced for Italian ryegrass control.

accepted.summary: Order of addition: broadleaf herbicide(s) first, then Axial XL Herbicide
accepted.quote: When tank mixing, add the broadleaf herbicide(s) to the spray tank first followed by Axial XL Herbicide.

accepted.summary: Risk of temporary crop injury under extreme weather or crop stress conditions
accepted.quote: Precaution: Temporary crop injury may occur with tank mixes under extreme weather conditions or when the crop is suffering from stress due to inadequate or abnormally high moisture levels or extreme temperatures.

accepted.summary: Prohibition against tank mixing with non-recommended chemicals, pesticides, or fertilizers
accepted.quote: Note: Tank mixing is not recommended with any chemical additives, pesticides, or fertilizers that are not recommended on this label or other Syngenta labeling or recommendations made by Syngenta as reduced annual grass control and/or crop injury may occur.

accepted.summary: Minimum interval between sequential applications: 4 days
accepted.quote: Herbicides not listed for tank mixing on this Axial XL label, or other Syngenta labeling or recommendations made by Syngenta may be applied sequentially. For optimum results, apply Axial XL Herbicide first and allow at least 4 days after application of Axial XL Herbicide before applying these herbicides sequentially.

accepted.summary: Required rate for Axial XL Herbicide when tank mixed with Tilt Fungicide
accepted.quote: Apply Axial XL Herbicide at 16.4 fl. oz./A in a tank mix with Tilt Fungicide at labeled use rates.

accepted.summary: Required rates for tank mix: Axial XL Herbicide 16.4 fl. oz./A and Quilt Fungicide 7 fl. oz./A
accepted.quote: Apply Axial XL Herbicide at 16.4 fl. oz./A in a tank mix with Quilt Fungicide at 7 fl. oz./A.

accepted.summary: Advisory about potential crop injury from Quilt Fungicide tank mixes under certain environmental conditions
accepted.quote: Note: Under certain environmental conditions, tank mixes of Quilt Fungicide plus herbicides may cause crop injury.

accepted.quote: Apply Axial XL Herbicide at 16.4 fl. oz./A in a tank mix with Warrior II with Zeon Technology at labeled use rates.

accepted.applies_to: tank mixing with Karate with Zeon Technology
accepted.summary: Required rate for Axial XL Herbicide when tank mixed with Karate with Zeon Technology
accepted.quote: Apply Axial XL Herbicide at 16.4 oz./A in a tank mix with Karate with Zeon Technology at labeled use rates.

accepted.summary: add axial xl herbicide to water first when mixing with liquid nitrogen fertilizers
accepted.quote: Add Axial XL Herbicide to the water first.

accepted.summary: liquid nitrogen fertilizer must not exceed 50% of final volume
accepted.quote: Mix thoroughly, then add the liquid nitrogen fertilizer in an amount no greater than 50% of the final volume.

rejected.summary: Maximum of two applications per growing season for herbicides with same mode of action unless mixed with different mode of action herbicide
rejected.quote: DO NOT use more than two applications of this or any other herbicide with the same mode of action in a single growing season unless mixed with an herbicide with a different mode of action which provides overlapping spectrum for the difficult to control weeds.
